leadText: Misty's Clauncher (Japanese: カスミのウデッポウ Kasumi's Udeppou) was the only that in Pokémon Journeys: The Series, and her twelfth overall.
plainText:
Misty's Clauncher (Japanese: カスミのウデッポウ Kasumi's Udeppou) was the only that in Pokémon Journeys: The Series, and her twelfth overall.

==History==
=== ===
 
 first appeared in A Fated Face-Off!, when he grabbed Ash's Pikachu's tail with his pincer. came to his defense, and after a quick scuffle, decided that he wanted to catch the Water Gun Pokémon. However, he was stopped by , who also wanted to catch him, giving Clauncher a chance to flee. Misty then revealed that she had fished up Clauncher earlier and decided it was fate to capture him, having tried and failed multiple times. Unable to decide who deserved the chance, the two decided to fish for him and see who reeled him in first. Both were able to hook him, but unable to reel him in, so Clauncher suggested the two battle for the right.

Before they could start, however, hooked Clauncher with the intent to eat his meaty claw. Corphish was able to free him, and together they sent the evil trio blasting off. Afterwards, the battle was held between Corphish and Misty's Politoed. Misty won the battle, so Clauncher allowed himself to be caught by her. After being caught, he let himself out of his to train Corphish on how to better use .

In A Squad's Worth of Passion!, Clauncher was called out alongside and Politoed to help the Squirtle Squad stop a rampaging fire.

==Personality and characteristics==
 
Clauncher has a lot of spirit and love for battling, as well as respect for those who can battle. This was shown with his respect for Ash's Corphish, as well as deciding that whoever was the better battler would be his . He has a slightly mischievous nature as well, toying with both and when they were trying to reel him in.

Clauncher and Corphish grew to have a close bond in the short time they were together, sharing a mutual respect for their skills, battle prowess, and big claws. This was further shown after his capture when he released himself from his to give Corphish pointers on how to improve his over celebrating with Misty.

Despite this one moment, Clauncher seems to have completely accepted Misty as his Trainer. When Misty won the battle for him fair and square, he willingly allowed her to capture him and become her Pokémon. As shown in A Squad's Worth of Passion!, he loyally follows her commands without hesitation.

==Trivia==
Clauncher is Misty's only Pokémon introduced after Generation III.
Clauncher is also Misty's only Pokémon to only use moves of his own type.
Clauncher is the first identified Pokémon owned by a main character that was caught onscreen, yet the location of his capture remains unknown.
Clauncher is the final Pokémon to be caught onscreen by one of Ash's friends.
If excluding Ash's previously released rejoining his team, Clauncher is also the last Pokémon caught by any main character in .
